RULE: the effective decision date is the FINAL CALENDAR DATE of the month, whether or not XNYS trades that day
WORKED_EXAMPLE: 2027-05-31 remains the effective May month-end even though it is a US market holiday

TWO_DISTINCT_TIMESTAMPS.effective_month_end: the AS-OF date the decision is computed for
TWO_DISTINCT_TIMESTAMPS.rule: the runner MAY execute later than effective_month_end, but the decision MUST be computed AS-OF effective_month_end

EVIDENCE_CUTOFF.any X evidence or vintage created AFTER: MUST NOT enter that month's census or decision
EVIDENCE_CUTOFF.late_backfill: MUST NOT rewrite an earlier NO_LOOK or LOOK

why_calendar_not_session: there is no basis for tying the decision clock to a trading-session count; the maturity clock is already frozen in CALENDAR DAYS (MASSIVE_1M_SETTLEMENT_RELATIVE_CRITERION_V1 · e3675278ece6f27c) and the two must agree
